en-US:
New in this version:
- Courses: a new Turns section with step-by-step tacking and gybing.
- Sail trim: 6 new lessons (halyard, jib sheet lead, reefing, the slot, tell-tales, Trim Doctor).
- Race: bots now sail the whole course to the finish.
- Better translations in every language, full Polish spelling, race history dates in your language.
- The App Store and iOS settings now show all seven languages.

If the app helps you on the water, a short review helps other sailors find it.

ru:
Что нового:
- Курсы: новый раздел «Повороты», оверштаг и фордевинд по шагам.
- Работа с парусами: 6 новых уроков (фал, проводка стакселя, риф, щель между парусами, колдунчики, «Доктор трима»).

pl:

fr-FR:
